body:
QA run record for selector `priority:P0` of the 18.2.0 release test sweep (wave anchor #25807, card T1). Run by the `checklist-test` skill following `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`, for the Version Packages PR #25640.

## Environment fingerprint

- framework: `6679644a1a56b552d6864b125900221823ec78b3` (objectstack-ai/objectstack `main`, head at start, 2026-10-25T13:35Z), tree clean; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + `pnpm build --concurrency=2` 76/76 green; `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` green. The tree is unreleased, so `/api/v1/health` reports `version: 18.1.0` (52 pending changesets).
- console: `.objectui-sha` = `b41ed7f68956c8cfda21bc790548361af81b09ac`, built with `OBJECTUI_DEPS_BUILD_CMD='pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@object-ui/console^...' pnpm objectui:build` ("dist ready … from objectui@b41ed7f68956"); `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` equals the pin and `pnpm check:console-sha` is green, so `stale-console-bundle` is ruled out for every console observation. A pin move is in flight (#25810); the maintainer directed this run to stay on `b41ed7f68956`.
- app: `examples/app-showcase`; canonical boot `OS_PORT=PORT setsid pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:SCRATCH/ITEM.db`, own port per item (ranges 41101–41599) and own file DB per item; items that author metadata, install or plant rows booted from a scratch copy of the app. Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) + showcase seed 132 rows. Walled leg: the same boot with `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated`, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`.
- Tier 1: every framework file named in the items' `automated.ref`, one vitest invocation per owning package at `--maxWorkers=1`, serialised across runners with a file lock; the Playwright pin `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts` ran against a live boot with `OS_TEST_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`.
- Fixtures provisioned by the runners: v17 SQLite from npm `@objectstack/cli@17.7.0` (`os start`, real 17.x shape); local Postgres 16 (scram-sha-256) for the datasource matrix; personas minted by invite + sign-up or admin create-user + change-password.
- date: 2026-10-25 (UTC), container Linux 4 vCPU / 15 GB; runner: one orchestrator + 5 runner subagents in parallel (api ×2, cli ×1, browser/mixed ×2).
